messages:
Aisha: Heads up — GlobeFreight sent a manifest update that reclassified 6 APAC racks into a pooled shipment. ETAs widened to 2026-07-22 -> 2026-08-03. This touches several Q3 reserved commits. Need to decide priority buckets and customer impact ASAP.
Tom: can you drop the manifest id / snippet? also which customers are in the high-priority reserve?
Aisha: manifest MF-8921. Snippet from vendor: ```
Manifest: MF-8921
Units: 6 racks (OR-RI-8U)
Status: moved to pooled shipment (consolidation)
ETA window: 2026-07-22 - 2026-08-03
Note: customs backlog at SG port, may split delivery by POD
```
Diego: quick mapping — the pooled move means 3 of the racks are no longer guaranteed to land on the originally slated customer dedicated racks. Affected commits: resv-APAC-101, resv-APAC-114, resv-APAC-122. Total GPUs exposed ~48.
Rachel: impact matrix pasted: resv-APAC-101 -> 2 racks (critical support), 114 -> 2 racks (can accept 1 late but needs notice), 122 -> 1 rack (non-critical).
Tom: ok. Options: 1) swap in EU spare racks and update latency SLAs for those customers, 2) credit customers and queue them for next wave, 3) temporarily reassign Hosted capacity + burst to cover peak. Which do we prefer?
Priya: vendor credit window is negotiable but only if we accept pooled manifest and sign amended ETA clause. I'll pick this up if we agree to negotiate.
Aisha: prefer minimizing customer disruption — propose: try priority swap with EU spares for resv-APAC-101 (critical) + offer credits to 114 if they can't accept cross-region, keep 122 on pooled. Need confirmation from SRE on cross-region routing latency.
Tom: tagging @SRE — SRE team, can we route workloads for resv-APAC-101 to EU spares with traffic steering? Impact on p99?
Diego: SRE note: cross-region will add ~50–90ms p95 depending on region. If customers are latency-sensitive (we think 101 is), we should avoid unless they consent.
Rachel: customer outreach draft: short note, options (swap to EU, credit + priority in next wave, or delayed delivery). I'll draft and share by EOD.
Aisha: action list: Priya -> negotiate vendor credits + amended ETA clause (owner), Tom -> check marketplace/private listing flags and prepare reroute playbook, Rachel -> customer comms draft, Diego -> update reservation mapping and contras. Meeting in 15 for quick triage? :calendar:
Tom: I can do 10:30 PT for 15m. I'll create invite and include SRE and CS. :thumbsup:
OrionBot: Reminder created — "Manifest MF-8921 priority triage" at 2026-06-15 10:30 PT.
Priya: I'll ping GlobeFreight procurement lead and ask for manifest-level packing list + whether customs can prioritize release for dedicated racks.
Aisha: Thanks all. Try not to flip customer commits unless we have written consent. We'll escalate to Partnerships VP only if vendor refuses credit or expedited release.
